visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair and glasses, wearing a blue Mickey Mouse t-shirt, stands in a brightly lit modern kitchen. He leans over a black frying pan on a gas stove, using a wooden spatula to stir ingredients. (2) The scene cuts to the man standing in a hallway with minimalist decor and sliding glass doors; he talks animatedly to the camera. (3) Back in the kitchen, he is seen from behind and then the front as he opens a large silver double-door refrigerator and squats to search the bottom shelves. (4) Close-up shots feature his hands holding a plastic-wrapped package of dried bean curd (yuba), which he then places into a clear glass bowl and soaks with water. (5) In a series of fast-paced shots, he slices a fillet of fish, adds various condiments from jars and bottles into a white bowl, and mixes them by hand. (6) He continues prep by slicing ginger, leafy greens, and fresh okra on a wooden cutting board, then chops a salted duck egg into a fine crumble. (7) The cooking process begins as he ignites the stove burner, pours oil into the pan, and sautés garlic and salted egg until a frothy texture is achieved. (8) He adds mushrooms, fish, and broth, then covers the pan with a glass lid to simmer before adding the leafy greens and shrimp. (9) The man sits at a table and eats the finished thick soup with chopsticks, frequently blowing on the hot food and gesturing with his hands to express his enjoyment while talking.
